body.en:
A group of 4 boys and 3 girls are to sit in a row of 7 chairs. Find the number of possible arrangements if:
(a) All 3 girls must sit together.
(b) No two girls may sit next to each other.

Solution:
(a) Girls together: Treat the 3 girls as 1 composite block \( G \). We now have 4 boys + 1 block = 5 entities to arrange: \( 5! = 120 \). Within the block, the 3 girls can be arranged in \( 3! = 6 \) ways.
Total arrangements = \( 5! \times 3! = 120 \times 6 = 720 \).

(b) No two girls adjacent: First arrange the 4 boys in a row: \( 4! = 24 \) ways.
This creates 5 available gaps (including ends): \( _ B _ B _ B _ B _ \).
We must choose 3 of these 5 gaps for the 3 girls and arrange them: \( {}^5P_3 = 5 \times 4 \times 3 = 60 \).
Total arrangements = \( 4! \times {}^5P_3 = 24 \times 60 = 1,440 \).
Answer: (a) 720, (b) 1,440.

label.en: Worked Example B — Algebraic Structure & Vieta's Root Relations
label.ar: مثال محلول B — البنية الجبرية وعلاقات الجذور

body.en:
Solve the quadratic equation \( x^2 - 9x + 18 = 0 \) and verify the sum and product of its roots.

Step-by-step Solution:
  1. Factor into binomials: \( (x - 3)(x - 6) = 0 \implies x = 3 \text{ or } x = 6 \).
  2. Check Vieta's formulas: sum \( = 3 + 6 = \mathbf{9} \) and product \( = (3)(6) = \mathbf{18} \).
body.ar:
حل المعادلة التربيعية \( x^2 - 9x + 18 = 0 \) وتحقق من مجموع وحاصل ضرب الجذرين.

الحل بالتفصيل:
  1. التحليل إلى عوامل: \( (x - 3)(x - 6) = 0 \implies x = 3 \text{ أو } x = 6 \).
  2. المجموع \( = \mathbf{9} \) وحاصل الضرب \( = \mathbf{18} \).

question.en: [Permutations & Combinations · Practice 1] If the governing relation for this system is \( g(t) = 3t + 3 \), evaluate \( g(4) \) and find the inverse input \( t \) when \( g(t) = 18 \).
question.ar: [Permutations & Combinations · تدريب 1] إذا كانت العلاقة الحاكمة هي \( g(t) = 3t + 3 \)، فأوجد \( g(4) \) وكذلك قيمة \( t \) عندما \( g(t) = 18 \).

solution.en: Substitute \( t = 4 \): \( g(4) = 3(4) + 3 = \mathbf{15} \). Setting \( 3t + 3 = 18 \) gives \( 3t = 15 \implies t = \mathbf{5} \).
solution.ar: بالتعويض عن \( t = 4 \): \( g(4) = 3(4) + 3 = \mathbf{15} \). وعندما \( 3t + 3 = 18 \) فإن \( t = \mathbf{5} \).

question.en: [Permutations & Combinations · Practice 2] If the governing relation for this system is \( g(t) = 4t + 4 \), evaluate \( g(6) \) and find the inverse input \( t \) when \( g(t) = 32 \).
question.ar: [Permutations & Combinations · تدريب 2] إذا كانت العلاقة الحاكمة هي \( g(t) = 4t + 4 \)، فأوجد \( g(6) \) وكذلك قيمة \( t \) عندما \( g(t) = 32 \).

solution.en: Substitute \( t = 6 \): \( g(6) = 4(6) + 4 = \mathbf{28} \). Setting \( 4t + 4 = 32 \) gives \( 4t = 28 \implies t = \mathbf{7} \).
solution.ar: بالتعويض عن \( t = 6 \): \( g(6) = 4(6) + 4 = \mathbf{28} \). وعندما \( 4t + 4 = 32 \) فإن \( t = \mathbf{7} \).

question.en: [Permutations & Combinations · Practice 4] If the governing relation for this system is \( g(t) = 6t + 6 \), evaluate \( g(10) \) and find the inverse input \( t \) when \( g(t) = 72 \).
